introHtml: BEL badge ID holders offer reliable, clear vinyl construction that keeps credentials visible and protected. Whether you need simple pouches for a tradeshow or rugged holders with bulldog clips for daily use, BEL provides consistent quality across bulk orders. These holders work with standard badge sizes and are ideal for corporate events, schools, or government facilities. Choose from styles like the Easy Slide ID Holder or Vinyl Badge Pouch to match your security and branding needs.
